description:
# Task Templates Library

Create a library of reusable task templates for common development patterns (add feature, fix bug, refactor, write tests, update docs). Allow users to create and share custom templates.

## Rationale
Reduces time to start new tasks and ensures consistent approaches. Addresses user goal of reducing time from idea to merged code. Makes common operations one-click simple.

## User Stories
- As a developer, I want to start a bug fix with one click so that I don't have to write the same instructions every time
- As a team member, I want to share our team's templates so that we maintain consistent practices

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Built-in templates for common task types (feature, bug, refactor, test, docs)
- [ ] Templates pre-fill task description, acceptance criteria, and workflow settings
- [ ] Users can create custom templates from completed tasks
- [ ] Templates can be shared across projects
- [ ] Template usage analytics help identify popular patterns
